title: P15.10-B R1: remediate four audited findings — durable blocked dispositions, canonical wake binding, idle-write elimination, typed fault persistence; production stays RECONCILE_ONLY
description: Independent-audit remediation on PR #86 (audited HEAD 3b3d1dfccb17fd507fd3c9f4173a484e64068cff, BASE 88cdf85b99080b5b2da9dda13c9fae5154108c70). All four findings reproduced with executable tests before patching (5/6 new tests failed prepatch). F1: intake cursor no longer advances past events lacking a durable disposition — retryable faults (SQLITE contention, read-budget exhaustion, unexpected errors) stop the page at the last durable event and replay next tick; permanent faults write a deterministic intake-blocked SCHEDULER_RECEIPT plus best-effort sanitized quarantine. F2: accountWake now requires a WakeBinding whose canonical chain is re-verified hop-by-hop at write time (objective/auto_policy/objective_ref/work_item/agent/mission/approval); forged cross-objective sources fail closed, legitimate indirect Mission/Work-Item/Approval sources remain. Also completes the whitelist: objective_strategy_revision events now resolve (previously silently skipped). F3: reconcile/due progress rows persist only on real position changes or anomalies — idle ticks append zero scheduler commits. F4: durable state stores only typed fault codes (markDegraded last_error, quarantine blocked_reason); raw exception text never persists. Production wiring remains RECONCILE_ONLY: no consumer, no claim loop, no CEO/model/planner/controller/executor calls, no missions, no Telegram; driver_ready/consumer_ready false; COST_BINDING_UNVERIFIED deferred to P15.10-C. No merge/deploy.
